messages.content: 將一個2立方米的密閉室從25°C加熱到100°C，會產生多少氣體？

function.name: thermodynamics_calc_gas_pressure
function.description: Calculate gas pressure in a closed chamber due to heating Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

volume.description: The volume of the chamber in cubic meters. This is a float type value.

initial_temperature.description: The initial temperature of the gas in degree Celsius. This is a float type value.

final_temperature.description: The final temperature of the gas in degree Celsius. This is a float type value.

initial_pressure.description: The initial pressure of the gas in Pascal. Default is standard atmospheric pressure. This is a float type value.

message.reasoning: The user asks: "將一個2立方米的密閉室從25°C加熱到100°C，會產生多少氣體？" They want to know how much gas will be produced? Actually they might mean the pressure increase? The question: "將一個2立方米的密閉室從25°C加熱到100°C，會產生多少氣體？" In Chinese: "How much gas will be produced when heating a closed chamber of 2 cubic meters from 25°C to 100°C?" That seems ambiguous: maybe they want the pressure change? The phrase "產生多少氣體" literally means "how much gas will be produced". But heating a closed chamber doesn't produce gas; it changes pressure. Maybe they want the pressure increase due to heating. So we need to compute new pressure using ideal gas law: P1V/T1 = P2V/T2. So P2 = P1 * T2/T1. T in Kelvin. T1=25°C=298K, T2=100°C=373K. P1 default standard atmospheric pressure: 101325 Pa. So P2 = 101325 * 373/298 = 101325 * 1.2525 ≈ 126,800 Pa. So pressure increases by about 25.5% to ~126.8 kPa. The amount of gas (moles) remains same. So maybe answer: no gas produced, just pressure increase. Provide explanation. Use function to calculate? We can call the function thermodynamics_calc_gas_pressure with volume=2, initial_temperature=25, final_temperature=100. initial_pressure default. Let's call.
